 Technical Specifications
Fastener Torsion Tester QualiFTT™
Torsion Testing Machine QualiFTT™ is used to verify the suitability of high-strength bolt, nut, and washer assemblies for pre-loaded bolted connections in metallic structures. This test ensures that the fastener assembly behaves as expected, allowing the required pre-load to be reliably achieved using the tightening methods specified in ENV 1090, while providing sufficient margins against over-tightening and failure.
The torque is generated by a servo motor and gear box. The torsional angle is directly measured from the servo motor, and both the bolt force and torque are directly obtained from load cells.
QualiFTT™ 10000Nm
machine designed according to EN 14399-2
QualiFTT™ 5000Nm
machine designed according to ISO 16047
Applications
EN 14399-2 High-strength Structural Bolting Assemblies for Preloading - Part 2 Suitability Test for Preloading.
ISO 16047 Fasteners - Torque/clamp force testing.
Determination
QualiFTT™ Fastener Torsion Tester is used to verify the suitability of high-strength bolt, nut, and washer assemblies for pre-loaded bolted connections in metallic structures. The purpose of this test is to check the behavior of the fastener assembly to ensure that the required pre-load can be reliably obtained using the tightening methods specified in ENV 1090, with sufficient margins against over-tightening and failure.
The torque is generated by a servo motor and gear box. The torsional angle is directly measured from the servo motor, and both the bolt force and torque are directly obtained from load cells.
Fastener Torsion Tester QualiFTT™ Software Features
Windows-Based Platform
The software package is user-friendly and easy to use.
Multi Measurement Units
Dimensions, bolt force, and torque can be displayed in different units upon selection.
Programmable Test Methods
Users can develop an optimal test method based on the test specimen's material and dimensions. Once a method is established, the operator only needs to load the existing test process and click "Start" to conduct tests on similar specimens.
Editable Report
Users can configure an EXCEL report template to suit their needs.
Multi Curve Diagrams
Real-time display of Rotation/Bolt force (Clamp force) and Torque/Bolt force (Clamp force) curves.
Curve comparison is available upon selection.
Any part of the testing curves can be enlarged for detailed data analysis.
Language Packages
Different language packages are available upon request.
